_shape.name: required, unique
_shape.command: one command (use this OR commands, not both): an argv list like ["npm", "install", "-g", "pkg"] (preferred) or a string split with POSIX quoting — there is NO shell, so &&, |, ;, > and $() are rejected
commands: step 2 — run sequentially, stop at first failure; each step is an argv list or a string as above
_shape.cwd: optional working directory for every command
_shape.success_message: optional human-authored line shown on success; plain text or with placeholders; a default is used if omitted. Failure is always a generic 'Failed to install <name>.'
_shape._placeholders: in any command or success_message: {skills_dir} → active agent's <home_dir>/skills, {home_dir}, {agent_name}. Unknown {..} pass through. Placeholders are expanded per argv token after splitting, so a path with spaces stays one argument; no quoting needed.
